findings.summary: Tenant admins can open the history page but cannot load row details
findings.details: The tenant-wide page is routed behind `action.redemption.view_all_history`, and the test CLIENT_ADMIN fixture intentionally has that permission without `action.redemption.view_history`. However, row clicks mount the shared `TransactionDetailSheet`, which calls `getRedemptionDetail()` against `/redemption/requests/{id}`. The contract marks that detail endpoint as requiring `action.redemption.view_history`, not `view_all_history`, so a real CLIENT_ADMIN can list all tenant transactions but gets a failed detail sheet for any row. This blocks investigation/reconciliation workflows exactly on the admin history surface and is currently untested because the tenant-history tests mock the detail sheet away and the E2E only verifies the list/export path.
findings.tierReason: severity=high, confidence=0.90 (≥ 0.70), alreadyHandled=false — no PermissionGate or guard around TransactionDetailSheet at lines 356-360
findings.recommendation: Add an admin-compatible redemption detail path/contract guarded by `action.redemption.view_all_history` and use it from `TenantTransactionHistoryPage`, or explicitly grant/check `action.redemption.view_history` before enabling row details. Add an E2E case where CLIENT_ADMIN lacks `action.redemption.view_history`, clicks a tenant-history row, and sees the populated detail sheet.

adversarial-review.codexOutput:
# Codex Adversarial Review

Target: branch diff against main
Verdict: needs-attention

No-ship: tenant-wide history exposes clickable rows whose detail fetch is not authorized for the very permission that grants the page.

Findings:
- [high] Tenant admins can open the history page but cannot load row details (src/pages/redemption-history/TenantTransactionHistoryPage.tsx:356-360)
  The tenant-wide page is routed behind `action.redemption.view_all_history`, and the test CLIENT_ADMIN fixture intentionally has that permission without `action.redemption.view_history`. However, row clicks mount the shared `TransactionDetailSheet`, which calls `getRedemptionDetail()` against `/redemption/requests/{id}`. The contract marks that detail endpoint as requiring `action.redemption.view_history`, not `view_all_history`, so a real CLIENT_ADMIN can list all tenant transactions but gets a failed detail sheet for any row. This blocks investigation/reconciliation workflows exactly on the admin history surface and is currently untested because the tenant-history tests mock the detail sheet away and the E2E only verifies the list/export path.
  Recommendation: Add an admin-compatible redemption detail path/contract guarded by `action.redemption.view_all_history` and use it from `TenantTransactionHistoryPage`, or explicitly grant/check `action.redemption.view_history` before enabling row details. Add an E2E case where CLIENT_ADMIN lacks `action.redemption.view_history`, clicks a tenant-history row, and sees the populated detail sheet.

Next steps:
- Fix the tenant detail authorization/API mismatch before shipping.
- Add coverage for CLIENT_ADMIN row detail access on `/redemption/admin/history`.
